name: Borrowed Blades
summary: Kreza Darkthorn asks you to take the lumberjacks’ axes from Turner's Logging Camp. Their blades will supply materials for weapons in Rog'mar.

sections.title: At the Logging Camp
sections.body: Kreza Darkthorn keeps Rog'mar's forge running while Gur'dok breaks down the blades. The human presence to the south and Twilight to the west make gathering resources difficult. You are asked to bring back the lumberjacks' axes from Turner's Logging Camp, so their materials can be fashioned into weapons.

faq.answer: Kreza Darkthorn in Rog'mar asks you to retrieve the axes from Turner's Logging Camp.

faq.q: Why does Kreza want the lumberjacks' axes?
faq.answer: Gur'dok will break down the blades, and Kreza will use their materials to make weapons.
Turner's Logging Camp is south along the river, by the mill.
The human presence to the south and Twilight to the west make the fight for resources difficult.
